name: BACH_0149_FSIM_resample3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (78%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Resample-degraded simulated frozen section failed quality checks [F6]; recut, deeper levels, and margin deferral are drafted [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 78%, Invasive 20%, Benign 2% [F1] | Favors InSitu; 20% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% target coverage | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 44% reliability, 100th percentile OOD | Unreliable input; out of distribution |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Independent models disagree on top |
| Similar cases | 3/5 InSitu (60%), 1 Benign, 1 Invasive [F5] | Moderate neighbor agreement; mixed labels |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (+0.755) [F2]; 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (+0.352) raises risk [F3]; 20/20 spot check · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 6) · ↓ invasive · Typical score (-0.298) lowers risk [F4]; 19/20 spot check · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 1) · ↓ invasive · Low score (-0.224); 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197; faithful on n=132).
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes zero (-0.0088 to 0.0064, unverified); read leans on unreliable normal lobules (0/20) and mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 resample degradation on this simulated frozen section obscures invasion (20% invasive probability; neighbor BACH_0303 is Invasive).
- Out-of-distribution quality breaks conformal exchangeability, or tissue matches Benign contrast case BACH_0330 (73% similarity; differs in invasion).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 1, 7, 2**: Highest heatmap risk (98% to 100%); inspect for stromal invasion versus in situ carcinoma.
2. **Regions 4, 11**: Check duct-confined atypia (region 4) and stroma (region 11); ignore unreliable normal-lobule score.
3. **Regions 3, 10**: Review tissue margins and consider drafted recut, deeper levels, and permanent-section margin deferral.
